captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a small cylindrical snap-fit joint or clip-on spacer. It features a wide, flat circular base supporting a central hollow cylinder with a flared outer collar at the top to act as a retaining clip. A deep vertical slot with a rounded bottom is cut down one side of the cylinder to allow the walls to flex inward during insertion, while a smaller slit on the opposite side aids in flexibility.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric snap-fit joint with a flat circular base and a hollow cylindrical body. The top of the cylinder should feature a flared retaining clip and a vertical u-shaped slot to allow the structure to flex when compressed.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a difference() boolean operation. The additive base consists of a union() of three modules: 'socle' (a wide flat cylinder), 'cylindre_exterieur' (the main vertical cylinder), and 'clip' (created using an intersection of a hull-based conical flare and a central cube). From this combined structure, the code subtracts 'creu_interieur' (a union of a cylindrical inner hole and a top cone) and 'flex' (a vertical slot formed by translating and rotating a cylinder and a cube to create a rounded cutout).
